summary: Twin Vee PowerCats filed a Certificate of Change with Nevada to effect a 1-for-37 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective May 4, 2026, reducing authorized shares from ~19.6M to ~0.5M. The board approved unanimously on April 10, 2026; no stockholder approval required under NRS 78.207 as it proportionally reduces both authorized and outstanding shares. Fractional shares are rounded up, and adjustments apply to warrants and equity awards. No cash consideration. This recapitalization aims to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance. Watch for continued trading under symbol VEEE and potential further measures if price remains below $1.00 threshold.
